note: Tier-3 generic passthrough adapter for the Gemini CLI (spawn-gemini.sh, the same instantiation shape as the Aider worked example, issue #4780). worktreeIsolation is declared 'no' EXPLICITLY, not 'partial' -- it is flatly unverified, not 'close but gapped'. This refuses Builder and Doctor (both require worktreeIsolation) and Judge (requires loomControl) by the same mechanism that already keeps Codex's 'partial' out of Builder; check-runtime-capabilities.sh needed no code change to enforce this. No guardrail-parity document exists or is required for tier-3 -- see defaults/docs/runtime-adapters.md's tier-3 section for why that is safe. Intended use: a #8436 runtimes.preference fall-through tap (claude -> gemini) for roles with no runtimeRequirements, so an exhausted Claude token pool does not strand continuous roles. Promotion to tier-2 requires a guardrail-parity document, a CI smoke leg, and an honest re-declaration of capabilities.
